profile.headline: Software Engineer | JavaScript | MonogoDB | Express | React | Node |  REST API's (Healthcare to Tech)
profile.summary:
Proficient in a diverse tech stack: JavaScript ,Python, MongoDB, React, Express, Node, TypeScript, SQL, PostgreSQL, Web3, and DApps

With over seven years of experience as a respiratory therapist, I’ve had the privilege of working on the front lines of healthcare, delivering critical care and support to patients. This journey has honed my ability to remain calm under pressure, solve complex problems, and work collaboratively with a diverse team of professionals.

Today, I’ve transitioned these skills into the tech world as a full stack software developer. I’m passionate about creating seamless, user-friendly applications and leveraging technology to improve lives. My unique background allows me to bring a fresh perspective to development, combining technical expertise with a deep understanding of patient and user needs.

I enjoy learning new technologies, and exploring innovative solutions that bridge the gap between healthcare and technology. Outside of coding, I love traveling to explore new cultures, spending time in nature and making new memories with my family and friends.

I excel in spaces that allow me autonomy to champion success in those around me while building collaborative relationships within my team & throughout the company. Interested in learning more? Please feel free to reach out to me. I look forward to hearing from you!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Tested and engineered 45+ custom RESTful API endpoints utilizing Node.js to facilitate CRUD operations between the user interface & NoSQL databases such as MongoDB.
- Designed MVC architecture for large-scale projects, supporting continuous integration, smooth collaboration, and organization within an Agile (Scrum) team of 7+ developers.
- Kept thorough documentation and maintained Git history across projects, collaborating with team members through GitHub in a dynamic team environment.
- Designed and developed responsive user interfaces for complex web applications using React and Embedded JavaScript (EJS).

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
As a highly skilled and experienced freelancer, I have the ability to deliver outstanding results for clients of all sizes. I specialize in creating full stack web applications and e-commerce websites that are tailored to the unique needs of each client. Whether you are a small business or a medium-sized enterprise, I have the skills and expertise to help you achieve your goals.

I understand that each project is unique, and I work closely with my clients to understand their specific needs and requirements. I pride myself on being able to translate complex technical concepts into simple, easy-to-understand language so that my clients can make informed decisions.
positions.insights: Customer Support, Full-Stack Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Registered Respiratory Therapist
positions.description:
-Delivered critical respiratory care to over 100 COVID-19 patients in an intensive care setting, often during 12+ hour shifts.
-Managed and monitored 20-30 ventilators and advanced life support systems per shift, ensuring optimal patient outcomes.
-Collaborated with multidisciplinary teams, including 10+ physicians, nurses, and other healthcare professionals, to develop and execute treatment plans.
-Leveraged expertise to deliver individualized product and procedural training to over 200 patients, while providing comprehensive care to enhance their respiratory functions.
positions.insights: Employee Training, Process Improvement and +1 skill
